query:
SELECT s.id, s.platformOrderId, s.totalAmount, s.saleDate, s.channelId, s.customerId,
       COUNT(si.id) as itemCount
FROM sales s
LEFT JOIN saleItems si ON si.saleId = s.id
WHERE s.id IN (49560015, 49020030, 48990012)
GROUP BY s.id, s.platformOrderId, s.totalAmount, s.saleDate, s.channelId, s.customerId
ORDER BY s.id
